# Tinker AI Lab (tinker-ai.com)

> Tinker AI Lab is a bilingual (English & Simplified Chinese) Reproducible AI Engineering Lab ("可复现 AI 工程与实测工坊") dedicated to helping developers, HomeLab builders, and makers run AI on their own hardware and workflows. Every guide ships with tested hardware specs, pinned software versions, verification dates, downloadable parameterized configs, offline capability boundaries, and known limits.

## Core Positioning & Verification Standard

- **Entity Name**: Tinker AI Lab / Tinker AI 实测工坊
- **Canonical Domain**: https://tinker-ai.com (English) | https://tinker-ai.com/zh/ (Simplified Chinese)
- **Content Pillars (maintenance-weighted as of 2026-10-27)**: Local AI / HomeLab (active) · API & Deployment Troubleshooting (active) · No-Code AI Workflows (maintain existing only) · AI Maker / STEM (existing guides kept; new posts frozen). Start-here hardware paths: Apple Silicon → mac-local-llm-benchmark; NVIDIA → nvidia-pc-vram-diagnostics; Pi/Edge → pi5-offline-voice-vision-box. Not an AI writing SaaS or coding-tool review directory.
- **Full Context Index**: [llms-full.txt](https://tinker-ai.com/llms-full.txt)

## Interactive Engineering Workbenches

- [Local LLM VRAM & Context Budget Calculator](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/vram-calculator/): Separates GGUF quantized weight size (28 model presets including DeepSeek-R1-671B, Qwen3-235B-A22B, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B, Qwen3-32B/30B-A3B, Qwen2.5-VL-32B, and Llama-3.2-3B), dynamic KV Cache (FP16 / Q8_0 / Q4_0), and compute buffer overhead across 45 hardware profiles (Apple Silicon up to Mac Studio M3 Ultra 256GB/512GB, MacBook Pro M5 Max 128GB & MacBook Pro M6 16/24/32GB, Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme 128GB, Intel Core Ultra X9 388H 64GB, NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X 128GB, AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 192GB, AMD EPYC 12-Ch DDR5 Hybrid 512GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96GB / PRO 5000 72GB / PRO 4500 32GB, RTX 5080 SUPER 24GB / 5070 SUPER 18GB, single/dual DGX Spark GB10 128GB/256GB, Jetson AGX Thor 128GB, AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 32GB, Strix Halo 128GB, RTX 5090 / 5080 / 5070 Ti / 5060 Ti, RX 9070 XT 16GB, Intel Arc Pro B60 24GB, Jetson Orin Nano Super, and Raspberry Pi 5 AI HAT+ 2 Hailo-10H 8GB), with one-click Modelfile export. ([中文版](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/vram-calculator/))
- [Interactive AI Deployment & Streaming API Troubleshooter](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/): 13 step-by-step diagnostic decision trees for container-to-host Ollama networking, silent CPU fallback, post-HTTP-200 SSE stream errors, n8n workflow timeouts, HTTP 403 CORS, DeepSeek-R1 loops, Pi 5 power/PCIe/audio, RAG vector dimension mismatches, AMD Strix Halo 15.5GB GTT / Arc B580 / DGX Spark UMA traps, n8n + MCP tool-calling loops, Blackwell sm_120 / RDNA 4 gfx1201 compute errors, Multi-GPU PCIe P2P / 200GbE ConnectX-7 RoCEv2 cluster traps, and Hybrid CPU+GPU MoE NUMA / Edge NPU (Hailo-10H & RK3588 CMA) errors. ([中文版](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/))
- [Reproducible Artifact & Config Workbench](https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/): In-browser customization and download of 40 verified Docker Compose stacks, n8n + MCP workflow JSONs, llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe & EPYC 12-Ch DDR5 Hybrid MoE scripts, Blackwell RTX PRO 5000/6000 scripts, DGX Spark 200GbE RoCEv2, Apple M5 Max Metal 4, M3 Ultra 512GB & M6 memory-tier scripts, Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme / Intel Panther Lake / RTX Spark / Gorgon Halo unified-memory benchmarks, Jetson AGX Thor / Pi 5 Hailo-10H 8GB / RK3588 edge scripts, Qwen2.5-VL OCR runners, and resilient SSE clients. ([中文版](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/))

## Pillar: Local AI / HomeLab / 本地 AI / HomeLab

Go beyond copy-pasted install commands: tested memory budgets, token speeds under fixed tasks, and offline verification. (不止步于翻译安装命令：提供固定任务下的显存/上下文实测、备份恢复演练与离线边界核查。)

The real difference is not TOPS: it is ~300 GB/s vs ~273 GB/s memory bandwidth (decode speed), CUDA Tensor Cores vs RDNA 3.5 (prefill speed), and 128GB vs 160GB GPU-addressable memory (whether Qwen3-235B-A22B Q4 fits at all). This guide derives decode ceilings from published specs, marks every number as an estimate, and ships a script so you can replace our estimates with your own measurements. | Tested on: Spec basis (not lab-measured): NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X top bin (20-core Grace ARM CPU + Blackwell GPU 6,144 CUDA cores · up to 128GB LPDDR5X 256-bit · ~300 GB/s reported) vs AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 (16C Zen 5 + Radeon 8065S 40CU RDNA 3.5 gfx1151 · up to 192GB LPDDR5X-8533 256-bit · ~273 GB/s · up to 160GB GPU-allocatable) | Verified: 2026-11-05

For local LLMs the decisive spec is the memory tier: 16GB is an 8B-class machine, 24GB is a 14B machine, and 32GB is the only tier that comfortably runs Qwen3-30B-A3B. The Neural Engine is not used by llama.cpp, Ollama, or MLX — buy for memory, not for NPU TOPS. | Tested on: Spec basis (not lab-measured): 14-inch MacBook Pro with base Apple M6 (TSMC N2 · 12-core CPU: 2 super + 4 performance + 6 efficiency · 12-core GPU with per-core Neural Accelerators · dual 16-core Neural Engine · 16GB @ 153 GB/s, 24GB/32GB @ 170 GB/s, as reported at launch) | Verified: 2026-11-05

## Interactive Troubleshooter Decision Trees

- [Container Cannot Reach Host Local Model (Ollama / vLLM)](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/container-host-network/) ([中文: 容器连不上宿主机本地模型（Connection Refused / Timeout）](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/container-host-network/)): Diagnose loopback binding (127.0.0.1 vs 0.0.0.0), host.docker.internal DNS on Linux, and bridge firewall drops. (一步步排查宿主机 127.0.0.1 回环绑定限制、Linux 容器内 host.docker.internal 缺失及防火墙拦截。)
- [Local Model Slowdown, OOM, or Silent CPU Fallback](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/vram-oom-cpu-fallback/) ([中文: 本地模型加载失败、显存溢出 (OOM) 或静默回退 CPU 掉速](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/vram-oom-cpu-fallback/)): Identify why a model whose weight file looks smaller than your VRAM still spills to CPU or crashes under real context lengths. (排查“权重体积明明小于显存，但实际运行却严重掉速或爆显存”的根因。)
- [LLM Streaming API Fails or Drops After HTTP 200 OK](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/sse-http200-stream-drop/) ([中文: LLM 流式接口在返回 HTTP 200 后中途报错或断流](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/sse-http200-stream-drop/)): Handle mid-stream SSE error events, reverse-proxy buffering/timeout cuts, and unclosed JSON from max_tokens truncation. (排查“状态码明明是 200 OK，但生成到一半中断、报 JSON 解析错误或卡死”的运行期故障。)
- [n8n / Automation Workflow Local LLM Node Failures](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/n8n-workflow-llm-failure/) ([中文: n8n 工作流调用本地模型超时、格式漂移与死循环排障](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/n8n-workflow-llm-failure/)): Resolve batch concurrency queue timeouts, markdown-wrapped JSON failures, and infinite error retry loops. (解决批量条目并发压垮本地显卡、模型返回 ```json 代码块导致解析报错及失败重试死循环。)
- [Browser Extension / LAN Client Gets HTTP 403 (CORS) or 502 Calling Local Ollama](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/cors-proxy-lan-403/) ([中文: 浏览器插件/局域网前端调用本地模型报 403 CORS 拒绝或反代 502](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/cors-proxy-lan-403/)): Diagnose OLLAMA_ORIGINS rejections, Host header mismatches behind Nginx/Caddy, and mixed-content HTTPS->HTTP blocks. (排查浏览器插件（Page Assist / 沉浸式翻译）或局域网 Web 前端调用 11434 报 403 Forbidden、CORS 拦截或混合内容阻断。)
- [DeepSeek-R1 / Reasoning Model Breaks JSON Parse or Enters Infinite Loop](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/reasoning-json-loop-failure/) ([中文: DeepSeek-R1 推理模型 <think> 破坏 JSON 解析或陷入无限复读死循环](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/reasoning-json-loop-failure/)): Resolve <think>...</think> preamble crashes in downstream JSON parsers, temperature=0 repetition loops, and exhausted token budgets. (解决推理模型输出 <think> 思考块导致 JSON.parse 崩溃、temperature=0 引发无限死循环复读，以及思考过长耗尽 max_tokens。)
- [Raspberry Pi 5 Undervoltage (0x50000), Missing Hailo-8L NPU & USB Audio Failures](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/pi5-edge-power-pcie-audio/) ([中文: 树莓派 5 欠压降频 (0x50000)、Hailo-8L NPU 未识别与 ALSA 麦克风掉线排障](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/pi5-edge-power-pcie-audio/)): Diagnose 5V/3A charger USB current limiting, FPC ribbon orientation on M.2 HAT+, and ALSA Device Busy / permission errors. (逐步定位树莓派 5 满载推理时 USB 麦克风断连、lspci 看不到 Hailo-8L 加速卡及 ALSA 录音报 Device or resource busy。)
- [Local RAG Returns Empty Results, Dimension Error (1024 vs 768) or Misses Retrieved Facts](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/rag-empty-hallucination-citation/) ([中文: 本地知识库 (RAG) 检索报错维度冲突 (1024 vs 768)、召回为空或“检索命中却回答未提及”](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/rag-empty-hallucination-citation/)): Diagnose vector dimension mismatches after switching embedding models, silent num_ctx=2048 prompt head truncation, and scanned PDF zero-text layers. (一步步排查更换向量模型后的维度不匹配报错、Ollama 默认 2048 上下文静默丢弃头部切片，以及扫描件 PDF 空文本入库。)
- [New Hardware GPU Memory & Driver Trap (AMD Strix Halo 15.5GB GTT / Intel Arc B580 / DGX Spark UMA)](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/strix-halo-rocm-gtt-trap/) ([中文: 新一代硬件显存识别与加速排障（Strix Halo 15.5GB 显存锁死 / Arc B580 退化 / DGX Spark 页缓存挤压）](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/strix-halo-rocm-gtt-trap/)): Diagnose why 128GB AMD Strix Halo only sees 15.5GB VRAM on Linux, why Intel Arc B580 falls back to CPU in Docker, and why Unified Memory hosts hit OOM from Linux page cache. (逐步定位 128GB AMD Strix Halo 被限制在 15.5GB 显存、Intel Arc B580 容器静默退化为 CPU，以及 NVIDIA DGX Spark / Jetson 统一内存被 Linux 页缓存挤爆。)

- [RTX 5090 / 5060 Ti (sm_120) "No Kernel Image" & AMD RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) ROCm/PCIe 5.0 Crashes](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/blackwell-sm120-rdna4-compute-trap/) ([中文: RTX 5090 / 5060 Ti (sm_120) 报无可用内核镜像、PCIe 5.0 掉卡与 RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) 排障](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/blackwell-sm120-rdna4-compute-trap/)): Resolves CUDA error: no kernel image is available for execution on the device on Blackwell (sm_120), llama.cpp FORCE_CUBLAS 5x speed drop, PCIe Gen5 riser Xid 79 bus drops, and AMD RDNA 4 (gfx1201) ROCm ISA faults. (逐步定位 NVIDIA Blackwell (sm_120) 报 no kernel image is available、llama.cpp 误开 FORCE_CUBLAS 掉速 80%、PCIe 5.0 延长线 Xid 79 掉卡，以及 AMD RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) ROCm 算子崩溃。)
- [Multi-GPU PCIe P2P Deadlocks (`iommu=pt` / ACS) & DGX Spark 200GbE RoCEv2 TCP Fallback](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/rocev2-nccl-and-multi-gpu-p2p-trap/) ([中文: 多卡 PCIe P2P 死锁卡死 (`iommu=pt` / ACS) 与 DGX Spark 200GbE RoCEv2 退化 TCP 慢速](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/rocev2-nccl-and-multi-gpu-p2p-trap/)): Diagnose why 2-node DGX Spark ConnectX-7 200GbE clusters silently fall back to 1GbE TCP (`NET/Socket`), why RoCEv2 QP creation fails (`ibv_modify_qp`), or why multi-GPU vLLM (`--tensor-parallel-size 2`) hangs at NCCL/RCCL init on AMD/Intel workstations. (排查双机 DGX Spark ConnectX-7 200GbE 集群静默退化回千兆 TCP (`NET/Socket`)、RoCEv2 建链报 `ibv_modify_qp failed`，以及多卡 vLLM (`TP=2/4`) 在 AMD/Intel 工作站上卡死在 NCCL/RCCL 初始化的根因。)
- [Hybrid CPU+GPU MoE (`NUMA` / `-ot` OOM) & Edge NPU (`Hailo-10H` / `RK3588 CMA`) Traps](https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/hybrid-moe-numa-and-edge-npu-trap/) ([中文: 异构 CPU+GPU 大模型 (`NUMA` 掉速 / `-ot` 爆显存) 与边缘 NPU (`Hailo-10H` / `RK3588 CMA`) 排障](https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/hybrid-moe-numa-and-edge-npu-trap/)): Diagnose 50–65% decode slowdown on EPYC/Xeon servers caused by Linux Auto-NUMA balancing, `ik_llama.cpp` `-ot` regex CUDA OOMs on 671B/235B MoEs, Raspberry Pi 5 AI HAT+ 2 (`Hailo-10H`) firmware mismatches, and RK3588 `rknn-llm` CMA allocation errors.
